reviews.text: Excellent service. I recommend Dr. Milena.
I was very well attended to by everyone, especially Dr. Natália Cornejo, she took great care of Theo and provided excellent guidance throughout the consultation.
Complete and attentive service!

Excellent place! From the valet who greets us so well, to the entire service team and doctors.

Izabel
Serena and Aurora, my cat granddaughters
Monique Sara from reception and the veterinarians Erica and Juliana! Wonderful! Impeccable service and super caring! I'm so happy I chose We Vets health plan for my cats!

We have a WeVets plan, and some of the professionals are great, but I've never seen such long wait times and such disregard for emergency patients. Every time, it took ages to be seen in an empty veterinary hospital. No one shows up to give an update or explain anything. The few times something was being done, it was when the dog was having a tantrum. I'm going to the ICU, about to lose my dog, and it took almost an hour for us to be seen when we arrived. We've come here a few times, and it's time for them to at least start updating us on what's happening with our pet or actually do something because this is complete negligence.
We are always very well attended to, with great care and speed!

I had a scheduled appointment, I arrived on time, waited for 40 minutes, and only when I asked why I was taking so long did they discover that the veterinarian who was supposed to see me didn't come to work... (even though I had told the receptionist when I arrived).
After waiting 40 minutes due to their mistake, the receptionist informed me that if I wanted to be seen, I would have to join the emergency room queue... at the END OF THE LINE... even though I had an appointment and had been waiting for a long time. The least they could have done was find a way to fit me in...
What a lack of respect for the customer. TERRIBLE!!

WARNING: After becoming part of the WeVets network, this veterinary hospital has lost its essence. I took my pet, who was limping, to be seen by an orthopedic specialist. After an x-ray, the veterinarian recommended SURGERY and even gave me pre-operative exams, despite the x-ray showing inconclusive results and suggesting additional tests. I questioned the hospital, which spoke with the doctor and CONFIRMED the need for SURGERY. Not satisfied, I sought another specialist OUTSIDE THE NETWORK who performed additional tests and it was NOT a case for SURGERY.

I consider this situation SERIOUS!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Their service is always fast and efficient; we always trust our pets to their care.
Bolinha (my cat) received excellent care at this clinic, with attention and affection. She had a bladder infection and is now feeling better after medication. Thank you Wevets Sena Madureira.
I received excellent service. The service was quick, and the veterinarian was very clear-headed, practical, and attentive. The reception was welcoming and professional.

The 24-hour in-person service is good. The problem is trying to speak to them beforehand to clear up any doubts; you have to call to request that the exams be uploaded to the app, and nobody answers. My pet went to the emergency room three times this week and needs a specialist, but the only available appointment is in 7 days. What's the point of paying for a plan if I can't get assistance, basic information, or a specialist appointment when I have an emergency? Very disappointed.
Excellent service!!!
Excellent service from reception to the veterinarian. The veterinarian is very competent. I'm really enjoying We Vets.

Excellent experience, no delays regarding the schedule, and great friendliness from the staff at the counter and the veterinarian who attended to Cora! I hope that, unlike health plans for humans, the quality doesn't decline over time!

The staff are excellent and attentive, my dog ​​has health insurance and I've been able to get several procedures done. I recommend them!
Amazing! I brought my dog ​​in for an emergency and received excellent care. The vet gave clear instructions on how to proceed with the necessary treatment.
I can only express my gratitude to the veterinarians and, especially, to Dr. Marcela. They were all fantastic with my cat. She's doing great!

I should have come here sooner, seen the reviews, and seen how mercenary this hospital network is, how poorly it takes care of its patients. One of my dogs almost lost an eye due to the lack of attention and professionalism on the part of the doctors, and the other one died.
My dog ​​died… Yes, he died, and nothing hurts my heart anymore.
Are you listening, wevets? He died…
It all started on August 24th when Joaquim went to the hospital with diarrhea. He didn't get better and returned on August 25th and was hospitalized. On August 27th, Sheldon was also hospitalized for the same reason, diarrhea, and he didn't want to eat anymore.
The doctor who admitted him was incredible, she was so patient, to the point of trying to get him to eat so he wouldn't have to be hospitalized. She recommended starting treatment with Fenzole because Joaquim already had diarrhea, so to shorten the process, she prescribed it, so why not, to take care of him once and for all? Unfortunately, he was hospitalized, and even though I bought the medication and took it to the hospital, they didn't use it. This meant three trips to the hospital because of Sheldon, and on the last hospitalization, another doctor also recommended Fenzole. I was furious because they hadn't used it the first time. Maybe my dog ​​would still be here for me to take care of him. He was hospitalized again and didn't come home. He passed away; he had a cardiac arrest. My dog ​​was hospitalized, discharged home, got diarrhea again, was hospitalized again, came home, and got diarrhea and blood in his urine again. He was hospitalized and only got worse and worse until he passed away. The feeling is that they weren't taking proper care of him, always a bunch of tests, and my dog ​​didn't come home.
Besides that, there was Joaquim, who, after taking him to the hospital so many times, didn't realize his eye wasn't right after he was discharged. My little dog developed an eye infection, a horrible ulcer, which burst while I was taking him to another clinic for emergency surgery. An expensive surgery, which still doesn't prevent it from affecting his eye and him losing it. After he was discharged from the hospital, I took him to the Wevets network twice because he was quieter, more lethargic, and they didn't see anything wrong with the dog, and worse, they called me in an emergency to take him to another clinic for emergency surgery because they couldn't take proper care of the dog.

And I took him to the hospital so many times, had tests done, asked for follow-up appointments, and nobody saw anything. What kind of doctors do you have there?

Besides reporting duplicate values ​​on the statements, they asked for a blood glucose test strip for Sheldon, even though he had insulin. They charged me for 3 x-ray projections, but they only did 2, I had to double-check to get a refund.
The chaos, the worst nightmare of my life.
I signed up for the plan based on a recommendation, I was going to close the Pet Love plan and went to yours, if I had known, if I had seen the Google reviews that only want to make money. Always more tests without explanations, and even though I paid for everything, today my dog ​​is no longer here with me.
You broke my heart, you ruined my smile, I spent almost 20 days living a nightmare with this hospital network.
The staff are excellent.
Loli was very well taken care of, she needed check-up exams.
Very attentive and kind.
I love the service at this hospital. The entire team is attentive and caring with the pets.
Excellent service! Everyone was very careful and attentive.

I'm having trouble cancelling my Premium Plan. In June 2026, after receiving a notification from the company about changes to the plan, I canceled it through the WeVets app itself, and after the procedure, the app indicated that the plan was canceled.

However, in September 2026, I received a notification informing me that the plan was still active. I contacted the company to clarify the situation and was referred to the department responsible for cancellations. I explained what happened, but I received no response, even within the stated business hours.

I tried contacting them again the following day and still received no response.

I am simply registering my experience and the difficulty I am having in obtaining clarification about a cancellation that, at the time, was done through the app itself.

I scheduled an appointment with endocrinologist Jessica dos Santos Garofalo on August 27th at 4:30 PM. They say there's a 15-minute grace period for lateness. I arrived on August 27th at 4:46 PM, was attended to by the receptionist at 4:47 PM, and he immediately said that the time had passed and the doctor wouldn't see me anymore. I said it was only 2 minutes, and he said it didn't matter. I insisted, and he went to talk to Dr. Jessica, returning in 6 minutes saying she wouldn't see me. I waited because I found this unbelievable. An important observation: I've been seeing this veterinarian for a few months now; my dog ​​has high cholesterol and needs medication. Practically every time I've had to wait 15 minutes or even more at appointments (not just this appointment but others as well), I have to wait silently and accept it.

I showed my Ciptea card because I am an autistic person. And that a 2-minute delay should be reconsidered by my driver. The receptionist, completely unprepared to deal with people with disabilities, didn't know how to say ANYTHING, neither to reassure me nor to find a solution. The other receptionists looked at me and did NOTHING. This receptionist went back to Dr. Jessica's room, and I waited in the hallway next to the room. I was already in crisis, extremely shaken, and outraged. He came out of the room, saw me, and didn't look at me. At the same moment, two women came, one a manager, responsible, I believe, for that unit. I explained EVERYTHING that happened, she didn't support me, when I said about my condition and that it was 2 minutes and they couldn't do that, she laughed mockingly at me while looking at another woman. She spoke to me the whole time pointing her finger at me.
Besides not resolving anything, she disrespected me, mocked my disability status, and laughed.
I left after 1 hour in that horrible place. I called the police crying, in crisis, and they calmed me down, telling me they could send a patrol car. Unfortunately, I didn't accept because I needed to work. But they suggested filing a police report and filing a lawsuit for moral damages.

I've had a plan since March 2025. For 3 of my animals. This consultation is on the most expensive plan, by the way. I went to numerous consultations, exams, and even a surgical procedure (which is very disorganized, as I had to repeat exams because it was past the deadline, because this veterinarian Jessica and Dr. Yuri didn't order exams or inform me of all the necessary exams for the surgery).

I have a question: I have a plan, but if I didn't have a plan, if I had this consultation and it was private and I was paying, wouldn't they attend to me either? I highly doubt it.

I demand an apology, I demand that Dr. Jessica and the manager of this unit make a formal apology.

I feel like I'm being cheated.
I signed up for the comfort plan about 30 days ago and went to get my pet vaccinated at the Sena Madureira unit on July 10th.
During the appointment, the veterinarian only asked a few questions, took the temperature, which was normal, and that was it. Then she said that before administering the vaccination, an ultrasound would be necessary due to reports of sporadic, more pasty bowel movements. Up to that point, we thought the service seemed normal, although overly cautious. The exam was scheduled for July 11th. No preparation was required. On that day, the veterinary consultation was charged, even though only the temperature was taken. The pet wasn't even examined.
On the scheduled day, we went to the unit for the exam and vaccination. The service was delayed by more than 20 minutes. After the exam, we went back to the veterinarian, who reported that the exam showed something in his stomach and that he should have fasted before the exam, as she didn't know if the image was of food or some foreign object. For this reason, the pet's vaccination was again denied, and he was asked to have another ultrasound, this time with fasting instructions.
To my surprise, at the payment counter, I was charged an advance payment for the waiting period, amounting to approximately 1.5 times the cost of the exam through the plan plus the cost of the exam itself, therefore 2.5 times the cost of the exam, because the ultrasound had a 58-day waiting period, and we were on the 30th day of the plan. For the other requested exam, I would have to pay again for the advance payment for the waiting period, in addition to an extra cost for the Sunday on-call service, which would be more than 3 times the cost of the exam.
No one had mentioned that I would have to pay the advance payment for the waiting period before it was scheduled and performed, and what is most astonishing is that a new exam is required because the previous one did not have the proper preparatory instructions. On this return visit, the veterinarian again only measured the temperature and nothing else.
In short, I haven't been able to get the vaccine, I've already paid for an exam and the advance payment for the waiting period without prior information and without any validity of the result because it wasn't properly prepared due to lack of guidance, and now they want me to pay again, besides the consultation also paid for just to measure the temperature.
Honestly, I'm not seeing any benefit from the plan, which so far is only serving to waste time, spend much more money than in the private network, and take the temperature. Not to mention the stress for the pet having to go there several times for nothing!
They could refund my money for the poorly provided service, or rather, the service not provided. That would be fairer!
I should cancel the plan!

I hope this note helps the administration or those responsible to better organize the reception and guidance for pet owners. I'm not the only one complaining here today, unfortunately. Thank you very much.
